holdings.name: Larsen & Toubro Ltd

what_changed.text: L&T reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹78,750 crore and PAT of ₹5,202 crore, supported by record quarterly order inflows of ₹147,665 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.98%, L&T is the fund's largest individual holding and acts as the anchor for its 26.7% Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Execution pace and margin trends across the ₹1,477 billion order inflow reported in Q2.

holdings.name: ICICI Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: ICICI Bank posted Q2 FY27 net profit growth of 20.1% to ₹14,843 crore.
The bank revised fixed deposit interest rates upward for general and senior citizen depositors.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighing 2.83%, it is the fund's second-largest holding and leads the 24.5% exposure to Financials.

watch.text: The impact of higher deposit rates on net interest margins and funding costs.

holdings.name: Kirloskar Oil Engines Ltd

what_changed.text: The company announced the resignation of its Company Secretary and Compliance Officer effective October 30, 2026.
The board scheduled a meeting for November 4, 2026, to review and approve Q2 FY27 financial results.

expected.text: Management stated a target of doubling company revenues by 2030.

holdings.why_it_matters: Carrying a 2.75% fund weight, the stock fell 17.80% over 3 months, making it the fund's largest single detractor at -0.490% contribution.

watch.text: Q2 FY27 earnings performance and volume growth during the November 4 board review.

holdings.name: One 97 Communications Ltd

what_changed.text: Paytm reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹2,648 crore with net profit of ₹225 crore.
A subsidiary's GST demand was reduced from ₹5,712 crore to ₹704 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.73% weight, Paytm was the portfolio's top 3-month contributor, generating a 21.69% return and adding +0.592% to performance.

watch.text: Management commentary on operating leverage and payment volume trends from the October 27 concall.

holdings.name: Reliance Industries Ltd

what_changed.text: Reliance reported record consolidated Q2 FY27 PAT of ₹29,550 crore and approved up to ₹15,000 crore of NCD issuances.
Subsidiary Jio Platforms completed its ₹30,188 crore IPO and listed on October 28, 2026.

expected.text: Pre-earnings estimates anticipated Q2 profit to top ₹21,000 crore driven by refining and telecom strength.

seeing.text: Actual Q2 FY27 profit of ₹29,550 crore beat the anticipated ₹21,000 crore threshold.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.66% weight, RIL represents over half of the fund's 5.0% Energy & Utilities sector and dragged 3-month returns by -0.291%.

watch.text: Deployment of capital from the ₹15,000 crore NCD issuance and post-listing performance of Jio Platforms.

holdings.name: Axis Bank Ltd

what_changed.text: Axis Bank reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹38,087 crore and net profit of ₹7,666 crore.
SEBI issued a final regulatory censure order against subsidiary Axis Capital.
The bank scheduled revisions to savings account charges and transaction limits starting December 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding 2.60% of the fund, Axis Bank pairs with ICICI Bank to drive the fund's second-largest sector, Financials (24.5%).

watch.text: Fee income impact from the revised savings account structure starting December 2026.

holdings.name: Interglobe Aviation Ltd

what_changed.text: IndiGo reported Q2 FY27 sales of ₹23,364 crore alongside a net loss of ₹1,879 crore.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.50% weight, IndiGo's 3-month decline of 5.67% compounded broader drag within the 26.7% Industrials allocation.

watch.text: Passenger yields and fleet utilization updates shared in the October 29 earnings call.

holdings.name: Kalyan Jewellers India Ltd

what_changed.text: Kalyan reported that Q2 FY27 revenue grew over 26% year-on-year, operating 546 showrooms with zero net debt.
The board scheduled a meeting for November 10, 2026, to approve unaudited Q2 FY27 results.

holdings.why_it_matters: At 2.18% weight, Kalyan was the fund's second-biggest 3-month detractor, falling 18.71% and pulling performance down by -0.408%.

watch.text: Full margin disclosures and festive season demand updates at the November 10 board meeting.

holdings.name: Zomato Ltd

what_changed.text: Eternal (Zomato) reported Q2 FY27 adjusted revenue of ₹24,621 crore with B2C NOV up 54% and EBITDA surging 197%.
The board approved an internal Going-out India restructuring and a share swap involving Adonmo and Mygate.

holdings.why_it_matters: Accounting for 2.17% of the fund, Zomato's 13.62% 3-month gain helped offset weak returns in traditional consumer discretionary names.

watch.text: Closing and integration milestones for the Adonmo and Mygate transactions.

holdings.name: MTAR Technologies Ltd

what_changed.text: MTAR reported Q2 FY27 revenue of ₹406.8 crore with EBITDA rising 483.3% year-on-year.
NCLT approved the amalgamation of two wholly owned subsidiaries into MTAR.

expected.text: Management indicated that second-half revenue growth will beat current full-year guidance.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.12% weight, MTAR surged 18.93% over 3 months, contributing +0.401% to fund performance.

watch.text: Order execution and delivery timelines supporting management's raised H2 revenue growth targets.

portfolio.statement: The fund posted a 3-month return of -5.02%, heavily dragged by mid-cap cyclical and discretionary holdings despite sharp gains in select industrial and tech names.
interp: Steep losses in Kirloskar Oil Engines, Kalyan Jewellers, and Reliance Industries outstripped strong rallies in One 97 Communications and MTAR Technologies.
The portfolio's heavy concentration in Industrials (26.7%) and Financials (24.5%) drove wide divergence between surging tech/specialized engineering and lagging industrial goods.
portfolio.line: Specialized engineering and fintech gains were overshadowed by sharp pullbacks in consumer discretionary and capital goods holdings.

drivers.text: Kirloskar Oil Engines fell 17.80% over 3 months, deducting 0.490% from fund performance ahead of its Q2 results.
One 97 Communications gained 21.69% over 3 months, contributing +0.592% following operational profitability improvements.
MTAR Technologies delivered an 18.93% 3-month return and +0.401% contribution as Q2 EBITDA jumped 483.3%.

themes.title: Industrial Infrastructure & Precision Manufacturing
themes.text: Heavy allocation to infrastructure execution and precision engineering exposed the fund to sharp divergence between specialized suppliers and traditional equipment makers.

themes.title: Large-Cap Banking Anchors
themes.text: The fund relies on private sector banking leaders with solid loan books to stabilize the 24.5% Financials allocation.

macro.why: Infrastructure and capital expenditure cycles directly determine revenue run-rates and order book health across major portfolio holdings.

macro.factor: Banking Liquidity and Cost of Funds
macro.why: Rising fixed deposit rates influence bank net interest margins and funding costs.

priced_in.text: Record order inflows of ₹147,665 crore at Larsen & Toubro are widely absorbed after Q2 FY27 earnings.
Strong Q2 volume and revenue expansion of 26% YoY at Kalyan Jewellers is already reflected following its October operational update.

could_change.title: Second-Half Industrial Delivery
could_change.text: MTAR's expectation to beat revenue guidance in H2 FY27 could re-accelerate returns if high-margin contracts execute on time.

could_change.title: Aviation Margin Recovery
could_change.text: IndiGo's return to quarterly profitability after an ₹1,879 crore loss in Q2 could reverse its recent drag on the Industrials sleeve.

portfolio.risk_note: With 51.2% of assets concentrated in Industrials and Financials, any slowdown in domestic capex or margin pressure from rising deposit costs could further suppress multi-cap portfolio returns.
